title: Resume Generator Application Config Schema
description: JSON schema for the application configuration

output_dir.description: Directory where generated resumes will be saved

output_filename.description: Filename for the generated resume, supports placeholders for title, date, and author

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing files with the same name

template_dir.description: Path to the directory containing a template.html.j2 file.

data_file.description: Path to the YAML file containing resume data.
